answer: Under provisional-shadow probation, every new identity in the oasis network starts as a shadow allowed to transact only 1% of normal value, like water seeping through karst before carving a channel. All shadows minted in the same rolling 24-hour window share one global throughput cap, divided evenly among them, funded by a small copper-denominated registry fee. 01% of the cap: mass identity creation yields near-zero utility, making the effective cost per fake grow nonlinearly with volume while honest newcomers pay almost nothing.
